messages:
Incident Bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in us-east-1. Error budget crossing threshold. Auto-pager: @oncall-sre
Alex (oncall-sre): ack, I'm looking. Seeing jump in 5xx + timeouts. Will triage.
Maria (eng-platform): quick glance at rate-limiter logs: a recent config push applied a global tenant cap of 10rps instead of 10k. suspect mis-typed value. Here's log sample:
```
[2026-03-15T02:10:12Z] ratelimit: apply_config commit=7a4d2a tenant=global max_rps=10
[2026-03-15T02:10:13Z] proxy: upstream timeout, code=502 target=model-host-1
```
OpsBot: recent deploy: `rate-limiter-config` by jordan at 02:09 UTC (commit 7a4d2a). See: https://ci.example/reports/7a4d2a
Alex (oncall-sre): ok that matches. 10rps global cap would cause cascading 429s and then 5xx from overload downstream. First mitigation: disable new config and rollback to previous.
Sam (eng-runtime): I can rollback the config. Patch command I'd run:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap ratelimit-config -p '{"data":{"global_limit":"10000"}}'
```
I'll also increase the proxy connection timeout temporarily.
Priya (oncall-sre): I can run the rollback if Alex wants to handoff. Alex (oncall-sre): I'm paging customers and handing to Priya for exec. I'm staying on thread until rollback completes. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (pm): rolling back now is good. We should also enable emergency fallback routing to smaller models to reduce backend latency.
Sam (eng-runtime): applied rollback patch at 02:12:34 UTC. Confirming config now shows `global_limit=10000`.
Maria (eng-platform): seeing 429s drop sharply, 5xx trending down. metrics: error-rate 5xx peaked at 18% -> now 2.1% over 5m.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT update: mitigation applied by Sam. Post-mortem required. Pager status: severity=sev2
Ryan (cust-eng): FYI I'm drafting customer message for impacted tenants (A, B, C). ETA 20m for send after confirm stable.
Alex (oncall-sre): handing oncall to Priya now. Priya is primary for next 4 hours. Alex: off-shift but available for quick questions. :wave:
Priya (oncall-sre): ack, I'm on. Monitoring CPU on model-hosts for residual backpressure. Setting alert for >5% 5xx in 1m.
Sam (eng-runtime): follow-up: config validation missing strict schema allowed numeric as string; will add guard to CI. Creating PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/452
Jordan (pm): please include communication plan in postmortem (customers notified, timeline, rollback details).
Maria (eng-platform): temporary measures we did: rollback config, increased proxy timeouts, enabled fallback routing. Next: lock down config deploys behind stricter validation and add canary for rate-limiter changes.
Ryan (cust-eng): sending customer note now: "We experienced elevated errors caused by a rate-limit config misapply; we rolled back and services restored. We'll follow up with root cause and next steps." I'll cc legal for enterprise tenants.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT resolved? degraded metrics below thresholds for 10m. Marking as mitigated, PM to track postmortem. :tada:
Priya (oncall-sre): closing thread once postmortem created. Posting final runbook action items:
- Add schema validation on `rate-limiter-config` CI
- Canary deploy for rate-limit changes (5% traffic)
- Include explicit numeric type checks
- Draft customer incident report

Alex (oncall-sre): nice quick turnaround. Good handoff. :thumbsup:
